expectations.text: Writes the messaging angle as a conversational customer sentence, preferably using verbatim review language
expectations.evidence: The Messaging angle field is written as a spoken-sounding sentence: "You don't have to guess whether a joint supplement actually works — this one was formulated by a vet, at the doses the science actually supports." The brief explicitly applies the say-it-out-loud test and contrasts it with the rejected tagline form ("'vet-formulated science' itself doesn't — it's a tagline, not a sentence a customer would say"), and the Completion test restates it in customer-thought voice ("this isn't another glucosamine-and-hope chew..."). The 'preferably verbatim review language' half is not met: no review
